title: Video Edit: Change the background ignores the picture - keeps the clip's place, or invents one from the words
description: Fabio 2026-10-15, live, NOT a pass. Clip: cartoon monkey riding a horse in a meadow (2 s, 512x960). Picture: square mountain landscape, sun top-left, pines, lake. Project 'Deepinfra model tests': flowVideoEdit_001 + _002 (no words) both kept the clip's meadow and sky, colour/texture shift only (SSIM 0.98 to each other); _003 (words: 'Snow-capped jagged mountain peaks and a still blue lake fill the whole background behind them; no open sky above the meadow') gave mountains from the WORDS, not the picture: different peaks, no sun. Ruled out: (1) the prompt - the engine's queued job carried the full Input_Look description of the picture and template 4; (2) a crop - node 110 MpiH3References -> core MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo ref_image_size 'match' scales the picture whole, aspect kept, crop 'disabled'. (3) MPI-1149's child-safety change touched no prompt. So H3's [video editing] mode anchors on <Video 1> and treats a place picture as a loose hint. Levers to bench: ref_image_size 'max' for the picture; a [reference generation] framing for op 4 (clip = moves, camera and its own characters, picture = the place), like template 6; an inverse mask (SAM3 the kept characters, re-render everything else). Also seen in _003's preview: the horse's head swung in front of the monkey's face (motion drift). Prompts stay positive-only.
